alt: 男子趁店主轉身，把錢盒藏進提袋；另一幕他坐在公園悠閒吃點心，袋裡露出同一錢盒，遠處警察正向店主查問。
meaning: 犯罪者逃避了應受的法律制裁，仍自由自在。
scene_prompt: 逍遙法外：採『犯了罪卻未受制裁，仍自由自在』，重點是犯錯者仍輕鬆享樂，追查的人尚未找到他。兩格台灣社區，左格成年男子趁店家轉身，把櫃上的無字小錢盒偷偷藏進袋裡；右格同一男子坐在公園長椅悠閒吃點心，袋口露出相同錢盒，遠處警察正與焦急店主查看空櫃照片，沒有注意到他。以相同衣服與物品交代犯罪和未被逮捕，不畫逃跑追車或危險動作。警察制服無徽章文字，兒童適齡，橫向三比二，1536×1024。
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website for elementary students in Taiwan. Landscape 3:2. Characters: Taiwanese (East Asian) children and adults drawn in a gentle Japanese anime picture-book style, natural expressions, age-appropriate child proportions (elementary-school kids look 7-12 years old). Setting: present-day Taiwan (Taiwanese schools, streets, homes, parks). Taiwanese school uniform = plain polo shirt or white shirt with shorts/skirt, or sports PE uniform; NO red neckerchief, NO red scarf. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain on warm ivory textured paper, paper texture visible. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy brown, generous ivory breathing room; no bright flat digital colors, no glossy 3D, no imitation of a named artist.
